platform_plan.content:
# Scope
Research-only architecture baseline for EP-01..EP-05 and EP-08; no rollout.
# Architecture
Canonical principals, signed content-addressed registry, exact-action grants,
per-scope projections, provider-neutral gateway, hash chain, outbox and reconciliation.
# Workstreams
Implement each accepted row behind its gateway and evidence gates.
# Milestones
M1 contracts; M2 bounded implementation; M3 production-like qualification.
# Verification
Re-run frozen corpus, probes A-P, sensitivity, security and canonical evidence checks.
# Risks
Inherited local-model, same-host, operator-n=1 and no-production-proof limits remain.
# Open decisions
PARK-01 legal, PARK-03 production SLO and PARK-04 profile-C stay deferred.

limitations: [S1-001] The auditor role is process-separated and adversarial but is not an external human or independently operated model.
[S1-001] The run verifies the frozen 12-record queue only; it does not verify all 176 historical u records.
[S1-001] Canonical pages and metadata were reviewed live, but full third-party content was not archived in this repository.
[S1-002] The benchmark is a short single-process local SQLite/WAL baseline with deterministic arrivals and a small read handler, not production traffic.
[S1-002] Distributed worker count, external calls, revocation, fan-out, failover, and multi-region behavior remain unverified.
[S1-002] The auditor role is adversarial and process-separated but not an external human or independently operated model.
[S1-002] The 20 ms p95 value remains an internal target; no production SLO or customer commitment is authorized.
[S1-004] Bounded evidence: Alloy scopes are 3-5 atoms per command; the TLC model bounds are 2 grants, 1 decision, Alloc=3, MaxTick=4, MaxPub=2; no unbounded proof is claimed.
[S1-004] The simulator exercises the design contract (transactional outbox, fencing, reconciliation), not deployed production code; Core AgentOS does not yet implement the grant/outbox service.
[S1-004] Producer and verifier labels, and acceptance reruns, are process-separated in one local environment; they are not off-host or external human audits.
[S1-004] Executed on a Java 8 JRE with tla2tools 1.7.0 (TLC2 2.15); the current tla2tools 2.0 build requires Java 11+ and was not executed.
[S1-004] LIVE1/LIVE2 are bounded traces (tick model, simulator replay) plus design obligations for the implementation, not unbounded liveness proofs.
[S1-004] Stale-ack fencing is zero in random acceptance runs by construction and is evidenced deterministically by probe A duplicate-ack suppression and the SAF2 negative mutation.
[S1-005] Boundary measurements are same-host and bounded; multi-host partition semantics and orchestrator restart latencies are unknown and excluded from scoring (bounded in sensitivity S3).
[S1-005] The recommendation is a research decision for the MVP; it is not a production deployment, availability, or reliability claim.
[S1-005] S1-002 and S1-004 evidence is PASS_WITH_LIMITS and is reused only within its stated limits.
[S1-005] Producer and verifier labels are process-separated roles in one local environment, not external human auditors.
[S1-005] The containers restart/recovery cell remains unknown until a bounded container prototype is measured (production deployments are out of scope for this ticket).

[S1-006] Model-based comparison on a same-host research station: durable-engine costs combine S1-005 E1/E2 measurements with documented lease/visibility assumptions (100 ms lease timeout, 105 ms modeled recovery); no vendor engine was installed.
[S1-006] Low/nominal arrival rates link to the S1-002 planning envelope; the 20,000/s high load is an explicit simulator saturation probe, not a production profile.
[S1-006] Multi-host partition behaviour and vendor timer semantics are unknown and excluded from scoring.
[S1-006] Producer and verifier labels are process-separated roles in one local environment, not external human auditors.
[S1-006] Migration triggers remain design obligations until a production-like follow-up benchmark measures them.
[S1-007] All results are local-model measurements from a deterministic stdlib-only simulation; no production latency, storage or privacy certification is claimed.

[S1-007] The timing probe is a bounded same-host paired-interleaved wall-clock measurement (200 paired samples x 32 inner repeats x 3 seeds per variant, tolerance max(10% of control median, 2000ns) recomputed by the evaluator from raw samples); it cannot prove absence of all side channels.
[S1-007] D9 (operational complexity/migration) and D11 (profile compatibility) are inference-type cells derived from the frozen contract, the current implementation and documented profiles.
[S1-007] Storage overhead uses a declared fixed per-index constant (256 bytes) - a model assumption, not a measurement of a production index engine.
[S1-007] S1-003 and S1-005 evidence is reused only within its stated limits (see dependency-gate.json).
[S1-007] Producer and verifier labels are process-separated roles in one local environment, not external human auditors.
